title: waymark_create: from tool call to shareable viewer
description: How an agent's waymark_create call becomes a verified JSON map and a self-contained HTML viewer, and how it is later reused as context. Key takeaway: every location is re-anchored against the working tree by its exact line text, so line numbers from the LLM are hints, not truth.
query: how does waymark_create work end to end?

traces.title: MCP entry and persistence
traces.description: The MCP tool handler resolves the repo root, delegates to the store, and notifies clients that the resource list changed.

locations.title: Tool registration
locations.description: waymark_create is registered with the flattened MapInput shape plus optional id/root, so LLMs see a flat, documented schema.

locations.title: Delegate to store
locations.description: The handler passes the raw map to saveMap, which validates, anchors and persists it.
locations.lineContent: const { doc, report, jsonPath, htmlPath } = saveMap(r, map, { id });

locations.title: Notify resource change
locations.description: Clients refresh the waymark:// resource list so the new map is @-mentionable right away.

locations.description: Zod parse, auto-assign ids (1a, 1b…), default linear tree, and reject dangling tree/link refs.

locations.title: Anchor
locations.description: Every location is verified against the files on disk; see trace 2.

locations.description: The canonical artifact: .waymark/<id>.json, meant to be committed and shared.

traces.guide: The tool [1a] is a thin adapter: it resolves the root and calls the store [1b]. **saveWaymark map** [1d] is the only writer: it normalizes [1e], anchors [1f], writes the JSON [1g] and the HTML [1h]. Finally [1c] tells MCP clients the resource list changed, which is what makes `@waymark:waymark://<id>` work immediately in Claude Code.

traces.title: Anchoring locations to real code
traces.description: Each location carries the exact text of its line; the anchorer finds it again even when lines shift or files move.

locations.title: anchorMap
locations.description: Iterates all locations with a shared FileCache and accumulates a health report (ok/moved/fuzzy/relocated/unresolved/missing).

locations.title: anchorLocation
locations.description: Resolves one location and attaches a code snippet and file hash used later for drift detection.

locations.title: Renamed file fallback
locations.description: If the path is gone, look up a tracked file with the same basename / longest path suffix.

locations.title: Exact line match
locations.description: Fast path: the claimed line holds the claimed text (whitespace-normalized).

locations.title: Moved line
locations.description: Same text elsewhere in the file: pick the occurrence nearest to the claimed line.

locations.title: Fuzzy fallback
locations.description: Partial text or symbol match; flagged so the agent double-checks it.

locations.title: safeJoin guard
locations.description: Paths are resolved inside the repo root only, so a map cannot read files outside it.

traces.guide: [2a] drives [2b] for every node. File resolution goes through [2g] (root jail) and falls back to [2c] on renames. Line resolution tries the exact line [2d], then the same text elsewhere [2e], then a partial/symbol match [2f]. Anything else is reported as `unresolved`, and the agent is told to fix it and resubmit with the same id.

traces.title: Reuse: viewer, context and drift
traces.description: The stored map is consumed by humans (HTML), by agents (markdown resource) and by CI (verify).

locations.title: Node selection
